title: MLZ bootstrap
description: The one-time setup of the customer's pipelines, run by Fortytwo with mlz-core's bootstrap.

github.description: The customer's GitHub organization and plan, repos, platform team, reviewers and runners.

plan.description: The customer's GitHub plan, which decides who approves an apply. enterprise: github.reviewers, in each role's environment (the default). team: GitHub allows reviewers on an environment in a private repo only on Enterprise, so the pull request's code owner approves its plan, and the pipeline applies only that plan.

repositories.description: The three repos, by role, and the organization's copy of mlz-core.

core.description: The organization's own copy of mlz-core, which the three repos' pipelines call.

platform_team.description: The slug of the GitHub team that owns the three repos: their CODEOWNERS name it, and its approval is required for every change but the contracts.

bypass_team.description: The slug of the small GitHub team that alone may change .github/ in the three repos (mlz upgrade, CODEOWNERS): their push ruleset refuses it from anyone else. It may also merge a pull request without a code owner's approval (pull requests only). Its members can therefore reach the MLZ App's key. Visible, and not the platform team.

reviewers.description: GitHub users who approve every apply, on GitHub Enterprise (github.plan). Not used on Team.

runners.description: Where the pipelines' Azure jobs run, for mlz install runners (docs/bootstrap.md, private runners).

kind.description: self-hosted: Fortytwo's runner image on a scale set in management's network (the default). github-hosted: GitHub's own runners, joined to that network.

size.description: An Azure virtual machine size for self-hosted runners (Standard_D2ds_v6 unless set), or GitHub's runner size for github-hosted ones (2-core unless set).

instances.description: Self-hosted: how many runners. Each is billed for its compute and Fortytwo's image from the moment it exists; 0 removes them.

app_client_id.description: Self-hosted: the client ID of the customer's runner App, which has only Organization > Self-hosted runners: write.

image.description: Self-hosted: fortytwo, Fortytwo's runner image, billed per instance and hour (the default); or dev, its dev plan, for Fortytwo's own tests in its own tenants.

state_operators.description: People who may run Terraform by hand against the state, by name: their Entra object IDs.

names.description: The bootstrap's own name for its resource group, state account or runners' vault, instead of the customer's template's (docs/naming.md): for a storage account or vault name taken elsewhere in Azure, or one to keep.
